instruction: Your parent says they got a message claiming to be from the government and demanding payment with a gift card. The FTC page is long, so use Microsoft Edge Immersive Reader to read it with fewer distractions. Then compose a new email in Thunderbird. Address it to `parent@example.com`, set the subject to `Gift card payment warning`, and include the page's exact sentence or phrase for whether the message is legitimate, what to do with the gift card company, and where to report the scam to the FTC. Do not paraphrase. Save it but do not send it
gt_steps: Open the FTC gift card scams page in Microsoft Edge.
Use Immersive Reader to simplify the page.
Read the sections about how gift card scams work and what to do after giving a card to a scammer.
Open Thunderbird and compose a new email.
Set the subject to `Gift card payment warning`.

Include these exact page phrases in the body: `No real business or government agency will ever tell you to buy a gift card to pay them`, `report the gift card scam to the gift card company right away`, and `ReportFraud.ftc.gov`.
Save the draft without sending it.

rules.subject: Gift card payment warning
body_points: No real business or government agency will ever tell you to buy a gift card to pay them
report the gift card scam to the gift card company right away
